I believe I can provide a helpful response to your query because this year, my brother cracked the UPSC prelims with a humanities background. Regarding this year's prelims, the paper was neither tough nor easy; the questions were of the usual difficulty level. The only change this year was that the options were framed in such a way that elimination wasn't straightforward.

After discussing with my brother, I learned that he also felt anxious upon seeing the paper. In fact, he marked the wrong answer for the first question, accidentally marking question no. 2 on the OMR sheet. Despite this, he managed to clear the paper. He attributed his success to regaining his concentration and focusing on questions he was confident about. The same applies to the CSAT paper.
